answer: An agent fund for ferrous scrap removal, sable habitat and summit trails grants one vote per irreversible one-token burn, never per key. Before allocation, its contract checks finalized burn IDs and owner signatures, counts each ID once, and cancels its vote on submitted proof of conflicting ballots; no refund. A 100-token budget buys at most 100 votes across 1, 10 or 100 keys, even for parallel farms or colluders. Extra identities add no quota. Late proof cannot undo spending; replay bugs break the cap. Wealth can dominate; this does not prove unique humans.
